title: Provide explicit reconciliation for positively rejected remote wake deliveries
outcome: Retain the original remote wake operation and delivery association after a proven local rejection that has no queued entry, expose its cause, and provide an explicit authorized reconcile/retire path. Never blind-replay an unknown runtime effect, mint a replacement operation identity, or undo local cancellation.
acceptance: A proven unsent local rejection with no queue association has a visible retained cause and an explicit fenced reconciliation path that uses the original operation identity; an unknown runtime effect and explicit cancellation remain protected from automatic re-execution.

Production-path tests cover failed channel, pre-send authority rejection, stale callback and explicit reconciliation; exact-input full gate and independent read-only review pair pass without outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher findings.
